title: MediKeeps - Hospital Management System
summary: A first-year group project intended to store patient information digitally so it can be referenced during medical emergencies.
team_context: The repository README lists Yash Anpat among six group members and describes it as a first-year project-based learning project at AISSMS College of Engineering, Pune.
limitations: Describe as a group project; do not attribute the entire implementation solely to Yash.
